between_angles: Security is the only configured release angle, so there is no second angle whose assumptions can leave a gap. I compared the complete v1.17.0-rc.1..v1.17.0-rc.2 change set with the security report: the candidate changes only the ordinary merge pass and its regression test, plus the prior candidate's QA records. The report re-checks the repaired fork-PR boundary from GitHub input through ticket mutation and merge, the other PR-reading paths, the mutation test, repository settings, tests and the unchanged delivery chain. The release gate remains responsible for CI. No concern was found unowned or between angles.
